bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for the Palliative Care Advisory Council.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; PALLIATIVE CARE ADVISORY COUNCIL. +]

[+$44,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for the Palliative Care Advisory Council under Minnesota Statutes, section 144.059. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for the Palliative Care Advisory Council.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; PALLIATIVE CARE ADVISORY COUNCIL.

$44,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for the Palliative Care Advisory Council under Minnesota Statutes, section 144.059.
additions: $44,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for the Palliative Care Advisory Council under Minnesota Statutes, section 144.059.
